Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Graphic designers annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Graphic Designers ($76,720). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $76,720, Chicago $66,490, Austin $65,060. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Graphic designers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Graphic Designers (6,590 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 6,590, Seattle 2,710, Austin 1,880. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Graphic designers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Chicago has the highest published location quotient (1.15). Published LQs: Chicago 1.15, Austin 1.14, Seattle 1.02.

What is the hourly median for Graphic designers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $31.28; Chicago $31.97; Seattle $36.89. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
